metadata.subtitle: Internal AI Rollout Simulator
metadata.description: Pre-computed simulation results comparing three AI adoption strategies.
metadata.model: Modified Friedkin-Johnsen with decaying mgmt signal, ramping training, innate shift, fatigue dampening.
metadata.disclaimer: Illustrative simulation for decision support. Not a prediction of actual outcomes.
metadata.author: Edoardo Miozzi

top_down.description: Management imposes the AI tool with a firm deadline. High initial pressure creates rapid compliance, but without training or champions the effect fades as the announcement loses momentum.

grassroots.description: Identify the top 10% most influential and tech-ready employees, train them intensively, and let adoption spread through peer networks. Slow start, sustained growth through organic diffusion.

full_alignment.description: Management communicates actively and consistently, training is broadly available, and 15% are identified as champions. All three levers produce fast adoption that sustains over time.
